description_en: Message producers and consumers must specify a unique Client ID when they connect to ApsaraMQ for MQTT to send and receive messages. A Client ID consists of two parts in the format <groupid>@@@<deviceid>. The DeviceID is defined by the client, and the GroupID must be created on the ApsaraMQ for MQTT server beforehand
description_zh:
消息生产者和消费者客户端接入云消息队列 MQTT 版服务端收发消息时，需要指定Client ID，用于唯一标识一个客户端。
Client ID由两部分组成，组织形式为<GroupID>@@@<DeviceID>，DeviceID由客户端自定义，GroupID需要提前在云消息队列 MQTT 版服务端创建
kebab_example: aliyun onsmqtt create-group-id --group-id GID_test --instance-id mqtt-cn-0pp1ldu0000 --api-version 2020-04-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateGroupId

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the group to create. This ID must meet the following requirements:

The ID must be 7 to 64 characters in length, start with `GID_` or `GID-`, and contain only letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores.

Group IDs cannot be modified after creation. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/42420.html
parameters.help_zh:
您需创建的Group ID。取值说明如下：

以 "GID_" 或者 "GID-" 开头，只能包含字母、数字、连字符（-）和下划线（_），长度限制在 7~64 字符之间。
Group ID 一旦创建，则无法修改，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/42420.html
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance to which the group ID belongs
parameters.help_zh: 创建的Group ID所在的实例ID
